theme: Neurotrophin-TRKA signalling through MAPK/ERK5 cascades
core_role: The shared pathways are the NGF/TRKA receptor-proximal adaptors (FRS2, ARMS) and their transcriptional outputs (CREB, ERK5, p38), framed as the neurotrophin-specific entry points into the generic MAPK cascades listed as additional.

theme: Mammary gland development and lactation
core_role: The shared pathways cover the alveolar/secretory stage of mammary epithelium (alveolar lineage, epithelial proliferation and differentiation, lactation), framed as the functional endpoint of the ductal branching morphogenesis in the additional set.

theme: Type 2 (Th2) immunity and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are the pro-type-2 drive (IL-33 alarmin signalling, Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13 production, mast cell activation, anti-nematode defence), with the additional set supplying its negative regulators and downstream IL-4/IL-13 and IgE effector signalling.

theme: E2F-driven cell cycle progression and checkpoints
core_role: The shared pathways describe the core proliferative cell-cycle program (E2F/RB-controlled G1/S transcription, G2/M transition, PLK/NEK mitotic entry, CDK4/6 and Chk1/2 checkpoint control), which the additional set elaborates with cyclin-CDK, ubiquitin-mediated degradation and RB-defect detail.

theme: Lipid modification and secretion of Wnt and Hedgehog ligands
core_role: The shared pathways concern ligand biogenesis by lipidation (PORCN palmitoylation of Wnt, HHAT palmitoylation and release of Hh-Np, Golgi trafficking), framed as the production side of morphogen signalling whose Hh autoprocessing and non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ outputs appear in the additional set.

theme: GABA and glutamate neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
core_role: The shared pathways cover the GABAergic transmitter cycle (GABA synthesis, vesicular loading, reuptake via SLC transporters), framed within the broader amino-acid transmitter turnover that includes glutamate reuptake and astrocytic glutamate-glutamine cycling.

theme: Nutrient and energy sensing by mTORC1
core_role: The shared pathways are the inputs and regulation of TORC1 signalling by amino acids (leucine), glucose and LKB1-AMPK energy status, framed as lysosome-based nutrient sensing (with cholesterol and rapamycin response as additional).

theme: cAMP/PKA second-messenger signalling to CREB
core_role: The shared pathways describe the generation, degradation and negative regulation of cAMP (calcium-stimulated adenylate cyclases, Cam-PDE1, cAMP catabolism) and its output to CREB, framed as the second-messenger layer upstream of PKA activation.

theme: TLR2/TLR4 bacterial ligand sensing and inflammation
core_role: The shared pathways describe detection of bacterial cell-wall ligands (LPS via LBP/CD14, lipoteichoic acid, lipopeptides) and the positive and negative regulation of TLR2/TLR4 signalling leading to inflammatory leukocyte recruitment, with MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies as the additional signalling-defect context.

theme: Leukotriene and lipid mediator metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways cover leukotriene synthesis, transport and catabolism (LTB4, LTD4, LTC4, omega-oxidation, lipoxin), framed as eicosanoid metabolism alongside the peptide-conjugated pro-resolving mediators (PCTR, RCTR, MCTR) in the additional set.

theme: Myoblast and satellite cell control in muscle regeneration
core_role: The shared pathways regulate myoblast behaviour (proliferation, migration, fusion and restrained differentiation), framed as the progenitor stage of skeletal muscle regeneration that depends on satellite cell maintenance in the additional set.

theme: FGF receptor signalling and oncogenic FGFR mutants
core_role: The shared pathways are the FGFR1-4 ligand binding and downstream FRS2/SHC/PLCgamma cascades, including constitutively active point mutants, framed as receptor-tyrosine-kinase signalling feeding MAPK activation.

theme: Thymic T cell development and selection
core_role: The shared pathways describe thymocyte selection and fate (positive and negative selection, thymocyte survival and apoptosis, proliferation, CD8 and gamma-delta lineage choice, migration, self-tolerance), framed as the developmental origin of the T cell activation and signalling programs in the additional set.

theme: Ionotropic glutamate receptors and synaptic transmission
core_role: The shared pathways concern kainate and AMPA receptor activation and presynaptic modulation of membrane potential and calcium/potassium channels, framed as the receptor machinery of excitatory transmission and short-term plasticity.

theme: Eye and retina development
core_role: The shared pathways describe morphogenesis of the eye's tissues (optic cup, retina, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, pigmentation, photoreceptor and amacrine differentiation), framed as eye development extended by retinal ganglion axon and optic nerve formation.

theme: RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling, oncogenic mutants and feedback
core_role: The shared pathways cover the negative-feedback and dephosphorylation control of the ERK cascade plus MAPK/MAP2K/MRAS mutant signalling, framed as the regulatory counterweight to the oncogenic RAS/BRAF/RAF1 activation in the additional set.

theme: Neuronal cargo transport to synapses
core_role: The shared pathways describe motor-driven transport of synaptic cargo (dense core vesicles, synaptic vesicles, receptor complexes) along axons and dendrites, framed as cytoskeletal trafficking powered by kinesins.

theme: LDL receptor degradation and cholesterol homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways describe lowering lipoprotein receptor levels (lysosomal degradation, reduced recycling, IDOL/LXR-mediated limitation of cholesterol uptake, VLDLR degradation), framed as one arm of cellular sterol homeostasis alongside SREBP-controlled synthesis.

theme: Mitosis: chromosome segregation, spindle and cytokinesis
core_role: The shared pathways cover the mechanical execution of mitosis (PLK1/Aurora A control, chromosome condensation and cohesion, spindle assembly and checkpoint, centromere maintenance, cytokinesis and nuclear envelope reassembly), framed as the process timed by APC/C-mediated degradation in the additional set.

theme: Notch and Hedgehog developmental signalling
core_role: The shared pathways describe Notch receptor proteolytic processing, intracellular domain transcriptional signalling and its oncogenic mutants, framed as developmental morphogen signalling alongside Hedgehog processing and GLI signalling in the additional set.

theme: LDL receptor turnover and cholesterol uptake
core_role: The shared pathways describe downregulation of LDL/VLDL receptors via lysosomal degradation and reduced recycling to limit cholesterol import, framed as receptor trafficking to the lysosome.

theme: Complement cascade activation and regulation
core_role: The shared pathways cover activation and regulation of the classical and alternative complement pathways, framed as the upstream cascade leading to the terminal membrane attack complex in the additional set.

theme: Base excision repair by DNA glycosylases
core_role: The shared pathways describe recognition and cleavage of damaged bases by glycosylases (NEIL1/3) and AP-site resolution, framed as base excision repair whose glycosylase defects (OGG1, MUTYH, NTHL1) appear in the additional set.

theme: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon
core_role: The shared pathways describe RIG-I/MDA5 and cytosolic DNA sensing leading through IRF3 to type I interferon induction, framed as innate antiviral defence.

theme: Amino sugar and nucleotide sugar metabolism for glycosylation
core_role: The shared pathways describe synthesis of glycosylation donors (UDP-GlcNAc via hexosamine pathway, sialic acid/CMP-Neu5Ac, mannose) and their disorders, framed as the substrate supply for glycosylation that the additional set extends to nucleotide sugar transport and GPI anchor synthesis.

theme: Craniofacial and limb skeletal morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe embryonic patterning of face, nose and limbs, framed as skeletal morphogenesis built through ossification, cartilage and cranial suture formation.

theme: UV/oxidative stress response and senescence
core_role: The shared pathways describe cellular responses to UV and oxidative stress leading to premature senescence, framed as a stress-induced growth arrest that suppresses p53-mediated apoptosis and fibroblast proliferation.

theme: Visual retinoid cycle and its diseases
core_role: The shared pathways describe the retinoid (vitamin A) cycle regenerating visual chromophore in rods and cones, and its inherited enzyme defects, framed as retinoid metabolism underpinning phototransduction.

theme: Inflammasome activation and pyroptosis
core_role: The shared pathways describe bacterial detection by AIM2 and IPAF inflammasomes leading to pyroptotic cell death, framed as inflammasome output that also drives IL-18 production and signalling.

theme: Inorganic anion transport and mineralization disorders
core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC-mediated transport of bicarbonate, phosphate, sulfate, iodide and oxalate and its genetic diseases (including enamel and ectopic calcification), framed as ion transport for acid-base balance and mineralization alongside proton exchange and pH regulation.

theme: Axon guidance by repulsive cues
core_role: The shared pathways describe semaphorin and netrin signalling controlling axon extension, repulsion and collateral sprouting, framed as the guidance machinery of axonogenesis and innervation.

theme: Platelet activation and haemostasis
core_role: The shared pathways describe platelet adhesion via collagen/GPVI and GP1b-IX-V, activation, degranulation and aggregation, framed as haemostasis driven by thrombin, ADP, and thromboxane/prostacyclin receptor signalling in the additional set.

theme: Norepinephrine transport and neurotransmitter cycling
core_role: The shared pathways describe norepinephrine reuptake and vesicular loading by SLC transporters, framed as part of the catecholamine/monoamine release and recycling cycle.

theme: p53-mediated DNA damage response and cell cycle arrest
core_role: The shared pathways describe p53 activation and stabilization after radiation damage leading to checkpoint control, CDK inhibition and senescence, framed as the DNA-damage arm of p53 transcriptional cell-cycle arrest.

theme: NK cell cytotoxicity and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe NK and T cell cytotoxic effector function (granzyme killing, degranulation, cytokine production, anti-tumour response), framed against the inhibitory KIR/MHC class Ib recognition that restrains it in the additional set.

theme: Notch signalling
core_role: The shared pathways describe the transcriptional output of Notch intracellular domains and its regulation, framed as the nuclear endpoint of Notch receptor activation and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutant signalling.

theme: Excitatory amino acid transport
core_role: The shared pathways describe glutamate/aspartate uptake by SLC1 transporters, glutamate homeostasis and their disease defects, framed as amino acid transport that also covers serine and glutamine.

theme: Nitric oxide-cGMP control of vascular tone and blood pressure
core_role: The shared pathways describe cGMP-mediated regulation of vascular smooth muscle contraction, blood pressure and renal sodium excretion, framed as the downstream physiological effects of endothelial NO synthesis and signalling.

theme: Ureteric bud and early kidney development
core_role: The shared pathways describe nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching, framed as the morphogenetic basis of kidney development.

theme: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral signalling
core_role: The shared pathways describe RIG-I/MDA5 sensing of viral RNA and downstream NF-kB activation, framed as innate antiviral immunity balanced by IRF3-driven interferon induction and negative regulation.

theme: Heart morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe formation of cardiac tissues (ventricular trabeculation and compaction, valves, endocardium, atrial muscle, coronary vessels), framed as heart development that includes aortic and mesenchymal contributions.

theme: APC/C-mediated mitotic exit
core_role: The shared pathways describe APC/C:Cdc20 regulation and degradation of mitotic substrates (cyclins, securin, Nek2A), framed as ubiquitin-ligase control of mitotic exit including the switch to APC/C:Cdh1.

theme: Carbohydrate metabolism: fructose, pentose phosphate and gluconeogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe fructose, pentose phosphate and glucuronate/xylulose metabolism, gluconeogenesis and their inborn errors, framed as central sugar metabolism alongside glycolysis and galactose catabolism.

theme: ESCRT-mediated membrane remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways describe ESCRT-dependent membrane fission for multivesicular body sorting, receptor downregulation and exosome formation, framed as a membrane-scission machinery also used for viral budding and nuclear envelope sealing.

theme: Cellular senescence
core_role: The shared pathways describe induction of senescence by oxidative stress and oncogenes, including the SASP and CDKN2A chromatin control, framed as stress-induced proliferative arrest that limits p53-mediated apoptosis.

theme: Renin-angiotensin regulation of blood pressure
core_role: The shared pathways describe angiotensin generation and signalling and renal control of blood volume and pressure, framed as systemic blood pressure homeostasis with renal filtration and vasopressin regulation.

theme: RAS-MAPK signalling and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe RAS activation (SOS, GAPs) and the RAF-MEK-ERK cascade with its negative feedback and mutants, framed as the core of oncogenic RAS/RAF signalling elaborated in the additional set.

theme: B cell activation and homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell proliferation, survival, differentiation, BCR signalling and germinal centre formation, framed as lymphocyte activation in lymphoid tissue.

theme: Cholesterol efflux, HDL and foam cell formation
core_role: The shared pathways describe cholesterol and phospholipid efflux via ABC transporters and LXR, HDL assembly and macrophage foam cell regulation, framed as reverse cholesterol transport.

theme: Ribosomal RNA transcription by RNA polymerases I and III
core_role: The shared pathways describe Pol I transcription of rRNA from initiation to termination and its chromatin regulation plus Pol III 5S rRNA transcription, framed as the first step of ribosome biogenesis followed by rRNA processing.
